around.headline: Trains between Bengaluru and Mangaluru to be regulated on Oct 3 and 4
around.summary: The Hindu reports train services on the route will be regulated on both days. If you are travelling this weekend, check your train's status before leaving for the station.

around.headline: Seven held in Bengaluru for printing and circulating fake ₹500 notes worth ₹21.68 lakh
around.summary: Police busted an inter-state counterfeit racket and seized 4,337 fake ₹500 notes. Check the watermark and security thread on ₹500 notes you get as change, especially in festival crowds.

around.headline: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper to start this month, about 16 hours
around.summary: Reports say South India's first Vande Bharat sleeper could start around October 10 or 11. Watch for the official timetable and fares before planning a trip.

around.headline: Pink Line elevated section set for safety inspection from Oct 6-8
around.summary: The Commissioner of Metro Rail Safety is likely to inspect the 7.5-km elevated stretch, a step before opening. No opening date has been reported.

around.headline: EC orders 'left out' voter drive; Karnataka CEO's order ends CM's six-hour dharna over voter deletions
around.summary: After about 13 crore names were dropped from draft rolls, the EC ordered a drive for left-out voters, and Karnataka's chief electoral officer issued an order that ended the CM's dharna over alleged deletions. Check your name on the electoral roll and file a claim if it is missing.

around.headline: Market crash wipes out ₹26 lakh crore in 8 weeks; soaring bond yields in focus
around.summary: The Economic Times looks at why rising bond yields may hurt the Sensex and Nifty. If you invest through SIPs, expect volatility rather than reacting to one bad stretch.

around.summary: The statement matters for the many Bengaluru tech workers and employers who rely on US visas. It is a statement for now; watch for any actual policy change.

street_smart.title: It's the long weekend and every outstation bus and train is packed. A stranger on a travel WhatsApp group says he has a 'confirmed' seat on tomorrow's special train for a small premium, and asks you to pay on UPI to a personal number to hold it. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Inshorts/Deccan Herald Oct 1-2: Bengaluru-Cherlapally special train to ease festival rush; Bengaluru traffic jam ahead of long weekend; BMTC adding outstation buses.
street_smart.situation: You need to travel tomorrow, official booking shows waitlisted, and he says the offer closes in an hour.

choices.text: Pay him ₹1,500 on UPI to hold the seat and ask for the ticket later.
choices.feedback: Scammers use festival rush and urgency. A personal UPI payment is unrecoverable and the 'confirmed ticket' never exists. A real ticket has a PNR you can verify before you pay.

choices.text: Pay half now and the rest after he sends a screenshot of the ticket.
choices.feedback: Screenshots are easy to fake and you have already lost the first half. Never pay anyone before the booking can be verified.

choices.text: Buy from a tout at the station counter who shows you a printed ticket.
choices.feedback: Unauthorised ticket sellers are illegal and tickets can be fake or in a false name, and you can be refused travel.

choices.text: Book only on the official IRCTC site/app or KSRTC/BMTC counters, check the special train or extra bus options there, and report the stranger's number.
choices.feedback: Official channels give a PNR you can verify and a refund path. Extra trains and buses are listed there, so no middleman is needed.

takeaways: Verify any train ticket's PNR on the official IRCTC site or app before relying on it.
Never pay a stranger's personal UPI ID for a 'confirmed' seat.
Report cyber fraud at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in as soon as you pay by mistake.

quiz.question: How many people were arrested in the fake ₹500 note racket in Bengaluru?
quiz.why: 4,337 fake ₹500 notes worth ₹21.68 lakh were seized. Genuine notes have a colour-shifting security thread.

quiz.question: Which Commissioner is likely to inspect Namma Metro's 7.5-km elevated Pink Line section from Oct 6-8?
quiz.why: CMRS safety certification is required before a metro stretch can open to passengers.

quiz.question: The new Vande Bharat Sleeper connects Bengaluru with which city?
quiz.why: Reports put the journey at about 16 hours, and say it is South India's first Vande Bharat sleeper.

quiz.question: Who chaired the Drafting Committee of India's Constituent Assembly?
quiz.why: Rajendra Prasad chaired the Constituent Assembly itself, while Ambedkar chaired its Drafting Committee.

quiz.question: Which layer of Earth's atmosphere contains most of its weather?
quiz.why: The troposphere holds about 75% of the atmosphere's mass and nearly all water vapour.
